definitions.gloss: resolution; resolving power; the smallest difference a measuring instrument can detect
definitions.explanation: A technical term for the finest distinction a measuring or observational instrument can make — for example, the smallest angular separation a telescope can distinguish, the smallest change in temperature a sensor can detect, or the pixel density of a digital display. Different from file or screen "resolution" in consumer contexts, which is usually {解像度|かいぞうど}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{顕微鏡|けんびきょう}→顕微鏡：05482_kenbikyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分解能|ぶんかいのう}。
examples.english: The resolving power of the microscope.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦センサー→センサー：29781_sensaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{分解能|ぶんかいのう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This sensor has a high resolution.

examples.japanese: ⟦{望遠鏡|ぼうえんきょう}→望遠鏡：05483_bouenkyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分解能|ぶんかいのう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ほど、{遠|とお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しく→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{観察|かんさつ}できる→観察する：21989_kansatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The higher the telescope's resolving power, the more detail you can see of distant stars.

examples.japanese: {電子顕微鏡|でんしけんびきょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{光学顕微鏡|こうがくけんびきょう}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{分解能|ぶんかいのう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{桁違|けたちが}い→桁違い：15744_ketachigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧、⟦ウイルス→ウイルス：05223_uirusu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{微小|びしょう}→微小：20095_bishou⟧な⟦{物体|ぶったい}→物体：13506_buttai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{観察|かんさつ}できる→観察する：21989_kansatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: Electron microscopes have resolving power orders of magnitude higher than optical microscopes, and can observe even tiny objects like viruses.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{分解|ぶんかい}→分解：08389_bunkai⟧ (decomposition, separation) and ⟦{能|のう}→能：01927_nou⟧ (ability, power). The word is built on the idea of "the ability to separate" — that is, to tell apart two things that are close together.

USAGE:
{分解能|ぶんかいのう} is a scientific and engineering term used in fields such as optics, acoustics, spectroscopy, metrology, and signal processing. It describes the smallest detectable difference along a particular axis — spatial, angular, temporal, or otherwise. Outside of technical writing it is uncommon; learners are most likely to meet it in textbooks and product specifications.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {分解能|ぶんかいのう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to have high resolution
- {分解能|ぶんかいのう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: to have low resolution
- ⟦{空間|くうかん}→空間：13754_kuukan⟧{分解能|ぶんかいのう}: spatial resolution
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧{分解能|ぶんかいのう}: temporal resolution
- ⟦{角度|かくど}→角度：00156_kakudo⟧{分解能|ぶんかいのう}: angular resolution

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{解像度|かいぞうど}→解像度：04888_kaizoudo⟧: resolution (image / display) — the everyday word used for screen resolution and digital image quality
- ⟦{精度|せいど}→精度：13787_seido⟧: accuracy, precision — how close a measurement is to the true value, conceptually distinct from {分解能|ぶんかいのう}
- ⟦{感度|かんど}→感度：17860_kando⟧: sensitivity — the smallest signal an instrument can detect, not the smallest difference it can distinguish
